description.value: Times Square Suites Hotel is a locally-owned, condo-style apartment hotel on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, operating since 1998 with studio-to-two-bedroom suites featuring full kitchens, in-suite washer/dryer, and a rooftop patio with BBQ grills. The hotel sits within a mixed-use building that houses restaurants and shops, with local grocery stores immediately outside the front door and Stanley Park a short walk away. It targets families, couples, and extended-stay guests seeking home-like comfort in a walkable, food-rich neighbourhood.
